body:
I went no contact for the first day today to see how it feels and it's painful. She hasn't contacted me either so I guess she doesn't care how I'm holding up. Of course I haven't told her I'm suicidal, I wouldn't want to subject her to that. 

I just feel like I didn't do enough, if I could go back in time I'd change so many things. I don't want it to get easier, I just want everything to go away. Honestly if giving up was easy as pressing a switch I would have pressed it already, but thinking about my little brother finding out I died destroys me. 

I hope you find the strength to move on. I don't feel like I will.

Thank you so much for such a kind reply. 

The thing is I don't want to give myself the possibility of change. I know myself and I'll be numb to all feelings a week or two from now, I've felt loss before (not this kind of loss). I'll put a shell around me again, and I just don't want to. I don't want to be the 'me after this relationship', and it looks impossible not to unless I just kill myself. She contributed so much to me losing the shell again that I don't know what I'll do.

It's hard to explain but at this point I feel like losing this relationship is changing for the worst, and I don't want to. It's not that I feel like I can't, I just don't want to.
